title: A WO demo's blog shows the restaurant's own posts, written by the build without a model; leftover demo posts unpublished only after the writes read back
steps: S1: run each engine's step against a fake site with a WO build (items + page plan): WordPress posts page, Joomla category/featured page, EmDash posts after the tool.
S2: make a write read back wrong; then retry a run whose posts were already written.
S3: run the step for a site no opportunity built.
expect: S1: the first N demo posts in page order get the items' titles and bodies in the CMS's own shape (escaped), slug/alias kept, published; the rest of that page's demo posts are unpublished; receipts and the old words are recorded.
S2: a read-back mismatch unpublishes nothing; a retry skips posts already written (EmDash rewrites one the model overwrote).
S3: nothing is read or written.
evidence: PR 1470; before it the agent pasted the items at hand-off (E2E wobrief 19/10/2026: Our History kept demo text, a run died on MALFORMED_RESPONSE)
fence: edit in place, read back before unpublish, never create or delete, WO builds only

tests: a category page: its first articles in the order the page shows them carry the posts, the rest are unpublished
an article another menu entry opens on its own is not written; a page showing subcategories lists them too
a written article that does not read back right leaves the rest of the page published
a retry skips the articles a run before wrote with the same post
a page that opens one article is not a list: skipped, said
a featured page writes the featured articles
nothing to write when the plan fills no list page
a site no opportunity built writes no post
Tracy Business: the posts the blog shows first carry the restaurant’s posts, slug kept and published; the rest come off
Tracy Base: newest first, same-day posts by their sort, and the restaurant’s posts land after the tool has run
a post that does not read back as written leaves every other demo post up, and is said
a retry skips a post this build already wrote, and writes the template’s words before it only once
a retry rewrites a post the site no longer shows as written (the tool ran again over it)
a read of the build that fails is said, and the build goes on with the template’s posts
only kept pages of the asked roles that the plan filled from posts are written, with their items in order
a body keeps its paragraphs and line breaks and escapes what a post typed
an excerpt is the first sentences up to the limit, cut at a word
the first demo records as the page shows them are written, one per item; the rest of that page are hidden
